general: Unplug devices that aren't in use to avoid phantom energy drain.
Switch to LED bulbs to reduce lighting energy consumption by up to 75%.
Wash clothes in cold water to save on water heating costs.
Use a smart power strip to automatically turn off peripheral devices.
Properly insulate your home to maintain temperature and reduce HVAC usage.

Air Conditioning: Set your thermostat a few degrees higher in summer to save on AC costs.
Clean or replace AC filters monthly to improve efficiency.
Use ceiling fans to circulate air and reduce the load on your AC.
Lighting: Turn off lights in rooms that are not in use.
Maxmize natural light during the day by opening curtains.
Consider installing motion sensors for outdoor lighting.
Heating: Set your thermostat a few degrees lower in winter.
Seal drafts around windows and doors to keep the heat in.
Wear warmer clothes indoors to rely less on the heater.
Water Heater: Lower the temperature setting on your water heater to 120°F (49°C).
Take shorter showers to reduce hot water usage.
Fix leaky faucets to prevent water and energy waste.
Laundry: Air dry clothes when possible instead of using a dryer.
Only run full loads of laundry to maximize efficiency.
Clean the dryer lint filter after every use.

high_usage: Your energy consumption is higher than average today. Consider turning off non-essential devices.
Peak hours are approaching. Try to shift heavy appliance usage to off-peak times.
Consolidate your tasks to minimize the time appliances are running.
